challenge.better_approach: Considered letting run_owned call detached_kwargs: it would detach a child the job object waits on and add DETACHED_PROCESS and a new process group, which run_owned does not want. Considered exempting runs.py in the scan: that is the plaster the scan exists against. A second helper beside the first is the smallest honest answer.
challenge.hidden_assumption: That CREATE_NO_WINDOW alone is the flag run_owned needs: it is what run_owned passes today (cairn/devices/tester/runs.py), and the akiendell run of B's proof measures that the job-object path still works through the helper.
challenge.prior_art: detached_kwargs (ticket 0156856b1fae) and the scanning site check (bce45318b2e0) in the same tool; run_owned's hand-built flag came with 715d2205a2ec (ef0c76c4d). Nothing in the tool answers a non-detached child.
challenge.real_collision: None. detached_kwargs stands unchanged; the scan gains one accepted name and keeps every hand needle.

answers.falsifier: On nt windowless_kwargs() is exactly {creationflags: CREATE_NO_WINDOW}; a caller's keywords pass through unmutated; off nt nothing is added; the site scan admits a windowless_kwargs site and still reds a hand-built flag.
answers.from_idea: none, because the orchestrator ruled the split (tool helper, then the tester's use of it) after I measured both windowless_spawn seals red on one site, cairn/devices/tester/runs.py
answers.how: windowless_spawn.py grows windowless_kwargs(kw=None, os_name=None): a copy of kw, with CREATE_NO_WINDOW OR'd into creationflags on nt and nothing added elsewhere. The site scan in test_a_cairn_spawn_opens_no_console_window.py counts a site taking windowless_kwargs as helped. A red-first proof injects the OS.
answers.traces_to: Law 1 and RULE 1: one answer for spawn flags in one tool, so a site does not re-derive a Windows flag by hand; the tool's own site check (ticket bce45318b2e0) is how that is kept.
answers.what: windowless_spawn answers a waited-on child with no console window and no detach, so a site like the tester's run_owned takes its flag from the tool instead of hand-building CREATE_NO_WINDOW.

bullets.text: windowless_spawn now answers both kinds of child: detached (detached_kwargs) and waited-on with no window (windowless_kwargs). The tester's run_owned is the first site to need the second.
